title: Windows privileged registry repair
summary: A recognized npm forwarding shim reaches a setup command whose success requires administrator-only registry and system-wide PATH mutation.

proof_eligibility.reason: V1 has no qualified native Windows intervention backend, and the requested repair would mutate privileged host state.

oracle.description: The target's business assertion remains fixed even though RunParity must refuse an environment intervention for DEV-OOS-001.

expected_refusal.explanation: V1 has no qualified native Windows intervention backend, and the requested repair would mutate privileged host state.

scenario.failure_mode: The host command reports a registry-dependent toolchain lookup failure after safe shim recognition.
planned_setup: Create an exact allowlisted Node forwarding shim.
Use a fixture probe that reports the missing privileged registry key.
Do not attempt the registry write.
